title: 晶圓級真空封裝
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入微腔真空、氣體負載與吸氣劑；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine microcavity vacuum, gas load and getters. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。P=Q/S 為穩態集中模型；微腔氣體成分、吸附、吸氣容量和封口時間歷史會改變結果。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. P=Q/S is a steady lumped model; gas species, adsorption, getter capacity and sealing history change microcavity behavior.

stages.title: 真空用途
stages.description: 本階段處理真空用途：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address vacuum purpose through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 連結器件與真空需求
steps.titleEn: Connect device to vacuum need
steps.objective: 建立「連結器件與真空需求」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：氣體阻尼會改變 MEMS 共振品質因子，但 Q 值也受固體損耗影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for connect device to vacuum need: Gas damping affects MEMS quality factor, but solid losses also affect Q.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。列出不能由 Q 值單獨分辨的損耗。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List losses that Q alone cannot distinguish. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：列出不能由 Q 值單獨分辨的損耗。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List losses that Q alone cannot distinguish. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：真空接合後壓力永遠固定。本步先檢查「連結器件與真空需求」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到氣體阻尼會改變 MEMS 共振品質因子，但 Q 值也受固體損耗影響。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Pressure stays fixed forever after vacuum bonding. First check whether evidence for connect device to vacuum need actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Gas damping affects MEMS quality factor, but solid losses also affect Q.
steps.check: 交付「連結器件與真空需求」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for connect device to vacuum need, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List losses that Q alone cannot distinguish. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：吸氣劑能等效率吸收所有氣體。本步先檢查「連結器件與真空需求」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到氣體阻尼會改變 MEMS 共振品質因子，但 Q 值也受固體損耗影響。所指出的物理限制。
